summary: Universal Display Corp filed an 8-K announcing a $400 million share repurchase program authorized by its board, in addition to first-quarter fiscal 2026 earnings. The repurchase is open-market, with no fixed expiration date. As an issuer buyback, this signals capital return to shareholders amid measured near-term market conditions but long-term OLED growth. No financial advisor or premium is specified. Watch execution pace and any insider selling patterns for capital allocation signaling.
